source.title: Call for Applicants - WEC Leader (July 2022)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new **WCA Ethics Committee (WEC) Leader**, as Blake Thompson is stepping down from this position. We would like to thank Blake for the work he has done leading the Committee.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 6 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Proactivity
* Clear background
* Trustworthiness
* Independence
* Accountability

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until **August 8th, 2022, 23:59 UTC** privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).
<!-- break -->
The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

* Brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* Ambitions as Leader of the WEC.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their application which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WEC can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2022.4](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.4%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2022.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: 招募 WCA 道德委员会负责人（2022 年 7 月）
translation.content:
Blake Thompson 即将卸任 **WCA 道德委员会（WEC）负责人**，我们将任命新负责人。感谢 Blake 在带领委员会期间所做的工作。

候选人应完成整个任期（24 个月），平均每周至少投入 6 小时处理委员会工作。我们希望候选人具备以下素质：

* 积极主动。
* 无不良记录。
* 值得信赖。
* 能独立判断。
* 有责任心。

申请截止时间为 **2022 年 8 月 8 日 23:59 UTC**。请将申请材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

* 简短的个人介绍。
* 曾为 WCA 开展的工作概述。
* 担任 WEC 负责人后的工作设想。

此外，请提交一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料副本。

WEC 的权利与职责见 [WCA 议案 10.2022.4](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.4%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf)。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将投票选出人选，再由高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认，随后公布新负责人。流程详见 [WCA 议案 10.2022.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
